rationale: Binary Int16 packing preserves CHELSA decode quanta (0.01°C / 0.1 mm) with measured maxAbsDelta≤0.01 and ~3–5× smaller gzip than JSON cells at density.
lookupLatencyNote: Single-cell map hit after tile decode is <0.1ms; dominant cost is one gzip gunzip per tile (~1–5ms for regional tiles).
